title: After That Conversation
description:
That afternoon you had coffee with Jiyeon was a month ago.
Today facing an investment decision, something she said came back.
"In this market, people are the asset."

choices.text: Reach out again. Want to hear more.
choices.result_text:
Jiyeon said 'I was hoping you'd call' and smiled.
Two hours of conversation.
What someone who's survived Gangnam says — it lands differently.

choices.text: Sit with the words and decide alone
choices.result_text:
You used what she said as a benchmark.
It worked.
Advice you digest on your own stays with you longest.

title: What Happened to That Stock
description:
When you talked investments with Jiyeon, she'd mentioned a ticker.
"It's not too late to get in," she'd said.
Today you pulled up the chart.

choices.text: Tell Jiyeon how it turned out
choices.result_text:
Jiyeon said 'See? What did I tell you.'
Confidence spreads when you're around someone who has it.
That was her power.

choices.text: Check it alone and decide whether to buy
choices.result_text:
You analyzed it yourself.
Jiyeon was partly right, partly off.
Verifying someone else's conviction — that's what investing is.

title: The Costs After Signing
description:
Three months after accepting Jiyeon's offer, the first statement arrived.
Acquisition taxes, interim-payment interest, legal fees, and escrow sat side by side.

Whatever happened to the property itself, these were the costs of carrying the contract.

choices.text: Ask Jiyeon to explain each cost
choices.result_text:
Jiyeon set the contract beside the statement.
'The interest changes with the schedule, and this escrow is reconciled at closing.'
You wrote the payment date and refund condition beside every item. Without asking, all of it would have looked like a loss.

You read the contract three times.
The costs were scattered across different clauses; together, they required a separate reserve.
From now on, you would calculate total carrying costs before signing.

title: Jiyeon Shows Up Again
description:
You turned down Jiyeon's proposal two months ago.
Today you ran into her at a café.
"Oh — oppa. Good to see you."
No trace of resentment on her face.

choices.result_text:
Jiyeon said 'Honestly, you were right to pass. It was a bit of a stretch on my part.'
Saying no doesn't end a relationship.
An honest refusal was the start of real trust.

A quick hello and out.
You didn't look back.
Jiyeon had started to say something — and let it go.

title: The Front-Wheel Estimate
description:
The day after the crash, at a neighborhood bicycle shop.
The mechanic spun the bent front wheel and said,
"Eighty thousand won, including replacement."

The 80,000 won in cash from the day before was still in {name}'s pocket.

choices.text: Use the 80,000 won to repair it now
choices.result_text:
{name} handed the mechanic one 50,000 won note and three 10,000 won notes.
Every won he had received went into the repair.

The new front wheel ran straight. {name} rode the bicycle out of the shop.

choices.text: Delay the repair and keep the 80,000 won
choices.result_text:
{name} took only the estimate and wheeled the bent bicycle back outside.
The 80,000 won stayed in his pocket, and the front wheel stayed bent.

He parked the bicycle outside the goshiwon and went in on foot.

title: The Name Sangchul Brought Up
description:
Over dinner today, Sangchul brought it up first.
"Minjun. You know Han Jiyeon?
She's been mentioning your name lately."

choices.result_text:
Sangchul said 'Good things. That you're someone who can be trusted.'
Jiyeon. Sangchul. In this network, reputation flows.
Reputation is made where nobody's watching.

You moved on naturally.
Sangchul changed the subject.
That one line stayed longer than expected.

title: After the Forgiveness
description:
That conversation where you forgave Jiyeon.
After that, something between you shifted.
Today Jiyeon appeared with something.
"There's something I've been wanting to give you, oppa."

choices.result_text:
A book.
Inside, a few words in pen.
'This is the first book I used to learn this world.'
Forgiveness came back like this.

Jiyeon was quiet for a moment, then said 'Thank you. I mean it.'
Forgiveness wasn't for a gift in return.
Jiyeon knew that too.

title: A Different Side of Jaehyuk
description:
After Jaehyuk unexpectedly helped you that time, you've been seeing him differently.
Today you ran into him again.
Still a complicated person — but somehow different.

choices.result_text:
Jaehyuk gave a short answer. Still awkward.
But you knew that wasn't the whole story anymore.
You stopped reading people by a single side.

You walked past.
So did Jaehyuk.
For a complicated person — maybe this is the right distance.

title: After Standing Your Ground with Jaehyuk
description:
The day you held your ground in front of Jaehyuk.
Everyone around went quiet.
Unclear if that was good or bad.
Today someone who'd been there reached out separately.

choices.result_text:
'You handled that well. I wanted to do the same but couldn't.'
Those words stayed for a long time.
People who hold their ground — stay in the memory of those who couldn't.

'It was nothing.'
They said 'No — it really was something.'
The person in it may not see it. But witnesses do.

title: News About Jaehyuk
description:
Half a year since you turned down Jaehyuk's request.
Today a call from a mutual contact.
"Hey, you know Jaehyuk? Things aren't going well for him apparently."

choices.result_text:
A business he'd stretched too far had stalled.
If you'd gone in with him, you'd have stalled too.
The refusal — was courage then and judgment now.

You changed the subject.
Jaehyuk's situation wasn't your problem.
The refusal was decided long ago.

title: The Next Level
description:
Six months since you moved up to the next tier in your specialization track.
Today a call from a senior in the same field.
"Heard about you. Where did you learn this?
There's a seat I know of — want to talk?"

choices.result_text:
It wasn't that skill knocks on doors.
When skill accumulates — doors find you.
Now you knew the difference.

choices.text: "Appreciate it, but I want to build more first."
choices.result_text:
The senior said 'Sure. Call when you're ready.'
You knew the door had opened — and kept it closed.
Not rushing is also preparation.

title: Being Recognized
description:
You got recognized.
After that, your name started to travel.
Today someone said:
"These days I keep hearing your name around."

choices.result_text:
'It is. That's why I'm saying it.'
A name that travels — was both an opportunity and a responsibility.
You have to do well even where no one's watching.

The other person smiled. 'Humility is also reputation.'
Being modest and being low are different.
There were people who could see that.
